short_description: Youper, an AI chatbot app for anxiety and low mood, closed on September 30, 2026. Accounts are being deleted.
long_description: Youper was an AI chatbot app, founded by psychiatrist Jose Hamilton, that guided users through mood check-ins and short exercises drawn from CBT, ACT and mindfulness. The company ended the service on September 30, 2026. According to its terms of use, users could export their data until that date; accounts and chat histories are deleted from October 1, 2026. A Common Sense Media assessment reported the app was no longer listed in the App Store or Google Play after April 2026. This page is kept for reference only.
patient_summary: Youper is no longer available: the service ended on September 30, 2026, and accounts and chat histories are being deleted from October 1, 2026. If you used it, look for another self-help app or talk to a clinician.

pricing.notes: Subscriptions were switched off before the September 30, 2026 shutdown; prepaid plans were refunded through the app stores (per press reports).

privacy.notes: Service closed; per its terms, accounts and data are deleted from October 1, 2026.

seo.title: Youper: AI Mental Health Chatbot (Closing Sept 2026)
seo.meta_description: Youper is a Stanford-validated AI mental health chatbot for anxiety and depression using CBT, ACT, and DBT. Note: Closing September 30, 2026.

faqs.a: Youper is an AI-powered mental health chatbot that delivers cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), and mindfulness techniques to help users manage anxiety and depression.

Yes, Youper has been clinically validated by Stanford University researchers. Over 83% of users report mood improvements, and JAMA named it the most engaging digital health tool for anxiety and depression.
Youper costs $69.99 per year with a 7-day free trial.
Youper is closing on September 30, 2026. Users should consider alternative AI mental health chatbots like Wysa or Woebot.

availability.note: Service ended September 30, 2026; accounts and chat histories deleted from October 1, 2026.
